mapper.select: SELECT gs.loan_date::date, 'loan' AS state, COALESCE(COUNT(ll.loan_date), 0) AS count FROM generate_series( CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 days', CURRENT_DATE, '1 day'::interval ) AS gs(loan_date) LEFT JOIN lib_loans ll ON gs.loan_date = ll.loan_date::date GROUP BY gs.loan_date ORDER BY gs.loan_date

SELECT gs.return_date::date, 'return' AS state, COALESCE(COUNT(ll.return_date), 0) AS count FROM generate_series( CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 days', CURRENT_DATE, '1 day'::interval ) AS gs(return_date) LEFT JOIN lib_loans ll ON gs.return_date = ll.return_date::date AND ll.loan_state = 'N' GROUP BY gs.return_date ORDER BY gs.return_date
mapper.insert: insert into lib_login_stat (userid, level, log_time) values ( #{userid}, #{level}, #{loginTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT gs.log_date::date, 'user' AS log_level, COALESCE(COUNT(s.log_time), 0) AS count FROM generate_series( CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 days', CURRENT_DATE, '1 day'::interval ) AS gs(log_date) LEFT JOIN lib_login_stat s ON gs.log_date = s.log_time::date AND s.level = 'USER' GROUP BY gs.log_date ORDER BY gs.log_date

SELECT gs.log_date::date, 'admin' AS log_level, COALESCE(COUNT(s.log_time), 0) AS count FROM generate_series( CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 days', CURRENT_DATE, '1 day'::interval ) AS gs(log_date) LEFT JOIN lib_login_stat s ON gs.log_date = s.log_time::date AND s.level = 'ADMIN' GROUP BY gs.log_date ORDER BY gs.log_date

SELECT scls_nm as ctg_nm, round(count_ctg_id * 1.0 / total_count, 2) AS percent FROM ( SELECT ctg_id, scls_nm, count(ctg_id) AS count_ctg_id, sum(count(ctg_id)) OVER () AS total_count FROM lib_books b INNER JOIN lib_cls c ON c.scls_cd = b.ctg_id GROUP BY ctg_id, scls_nm ) AS book_stat
